title: Platform Profile Execution
purpose: Defines the platform profile executor component that loads and executes platform profiles against the staged repository.

normative_requirements.text: The platform profile executor component shall load the selected platform profile by name, validate the profile against the platform profile interface contract, and execute the profile's required operations against the staged repository.

The platform profile executor component shall report profile execution outcomes separately from core initializer outcomes and shall not allow platform-specific behavior to suppress core validation or provenance recording.
